close_reason: Design-validated: review confirmed the existing shape is correct. No code change required. Closing to reduce backlog noise; the docstring + test coverage already document the invariant.
description: src/auth.rs:30,94 — TLS/trust-root concerns and per-request credential injection are kept in two independent traits. Result: CustomCaTransport can be paired with BearerAuth (private CA + bearer), DefaultTransport with NoneAuth (public + anon), and any combination works without combinatorial type explosion. A future contributor will be tempted to merge into a single 'JmapAuth' trait — that would force every credential scheme to know about TLS roots. Defend the split.
title: AuthProvider and TransportConfig as separate traits is the correct split
